scoring_justification: Headline effective exponents are compared to paper-derived gold, as recomputing from raw SCOZA fields is infeasible without running the full PDE solver in the verifier. The scaled EOS check recomputes δ from agent's data (T1), but overall tier is T0 because the main scored artifact uses result-level compare.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold effective exponent values and tolerances, derived from the paper's figures and textual descriptions.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Extracted from Figs. 1-6 and text of the paper: 'we find γ near 1.25', 'δ=5', 'β≈0.35', etc.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Read approximate curve values at specified (γ_r³, t) coordinates from the paper, cross-checked with known asymptotic limits.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values correspond to the paper's own reported and plotted effective exponents; they are the best available reference for a reproduction target.

types.exponent_type: string (one of gamma, delta, alpha, beta, gamma_prime, alpha_prime)

outputs.description: Effective critical exponents for each interaction range and reduced temperature; main scored artifact.

output_contract.notes: The verifier recomputes logarithmic derivative metrics on effective_exponents.tsv and checks the scaling slope (δ) on scaled_eos.tsv against a hidden reference. The instruction now requires the agent to determine β and δ from Step 2, eliminating the explicit gold leak.
